name: Farm Harbeest
description:
About This Game

Farm Harbeest is a top-down farm shooter with light incremental progression. Become an armed little bee, leave your cozy home, and set out across wild farms for an all-in-one harvesting adventure!

Frenetic Combat & Harvesting:
Take on mischievous farm animals, defeat them for drops, and harvest plant resources across the field. The more you fight and collect, the faster your efficiency grows—and the fuller your backpack becomes.

Base Upgrades & Tech Tree:
Return home with a pack full of resources, sit down at your computer, and begin your “hacker evolution.” With a huge branching tree of 100 skills, you can shape your own upgrade path: boost damage and fire rate, summon Black Holes for automatic harvesting, push dash speed to the limit, or unleash Split Stingers for overwhelming firepower. Become the strongest bee on the farm!

Explore Fantastical Farms:
Unlock multiple unique biomes—from lush forests to lively summer beaches, from vibrant autumn valleys to quiet snowy towns. Each area has its own animals and plant resources waiting to be discovered.
short_desc: Farm Harbeest is a top-down farm shooter with light incremental progression. Become an armed little bee, fight, harvest, collect resources, and keep upgrading as your firepower, efficiency, and harvesting range grow out of control.
